mapper.insert: insert into basket_stat_sync_record (match_id, official_result_id, sync_type, sync_status, idempotency_key, error_message, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{matchId}, #{officialResultId}, #{syncType}, #{syncStatus}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select * from basket_stat_sync_record where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
